updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting images in Microsoft Teams

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with images in Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to send or receive messages, upload images, or schedule meetings in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may be unable to send or receive messages, upload images, or schedule meetings in Teams.

More info: Users may also encounter issues with 
- Delays in sending and receiving messages 
- Creating new threads
- Signing in and out
- Scheduling service timeouts

Current status: We've received reports with Teams issues in GCC and we're analyzing recent changes and service telemetry to isolate the source of the issue. 

Scope of impact: GCC users attempting to send or receive messages, upload images, or schedule meetings in Microsoft Teams may be impacted by this event.

Start time: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 3:00 PM UTC

Next update by: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC

We're seeing positive trends towards recovery in our telemetry following our service's automatic scaling efforts to increase processing throughput.

This quick update is designed to give the latest information on this issue.

Next update by: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to send or receive messages, upload images, or schedule meetings in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may have been unable to send or receive messages, upload images, or schedule meetings in Teams.

More info: Users may have also encountered issues with 
- Delays in sending and receiving messages 
- Creating new threads
- Signing in and out
- Scheduling service timeouts

Final status: We can confirm after monitoring our telemetry that the automatic scaling efforts to increase processing throughput were successful and the service has returned to healthy levels.

Scope of impact: GCC users who attempted to send or receive messages, upload images, or schedule meetings in Microsoft Teams may have been impacted by this event.

Start time: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 3:01 PM UTC

End time: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 3:42 PM UTC

Preliminary root cause: We've identified that higher-than-normal latency impacted backend services that manage chat threads and messages, along with higher-than-normal Central Processing Unit (CPU) utilization resulted in our service entering an unhealthy state.

Next steps:  
- To help prevent similar impact in the future, we're further reviewing our alerting and traffic distribution systems.

We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
